tools.name: universe_get_viewer
tools.description: Return the signed-in Universe user and the host accounts they can manage (team memberships). Use a host id with universe_list_events. Read-only.

tools.name: universe_list_events
tools.description: List events (id, title, url, state, first date, venue, tickets sold). Without hostId it lists the signed-in user's own events; with hostId it lists that host account's events (ids come from universe_get_viewer). Read-only.

tools.name: universe_get_event
tools.description: Fetch one event by id: description, address, dates, capacity, tickets sold, sales amount, category and host. For ticket types use universe_list_ticket_types. Read-only.

tools.name: universe_list_ticket_types
tools.description: List the ticket types (rates) of an event: name, price, capacity, sold count, state and sales window. Read-only.

tools.name: universe_list_time_slots
tools.description: List the dates and time slots of an event (start, end, capacity, tickets sold, state). Optionally filter by start date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Read-only.

tools.name: universe_list_orders
tools.description: List the orders of an event: buyer name and email, state, price breakdown, created and updated time. Filter by order state, text match or updated-since time. Contains buyer personal data. Read-only.

tools.name: universe_get_order
tools.description: Fetch one order by id: buyer, state, cost breakdown, time slot, checkout answers and the ticket items with their check-in state. Read-only.

tools.name: universe_list_attendees
tools.description: List the attendees (ticket holders) of an event: name, email, ticket type, time slot, ticket state and checkout answers. Filter by ticket state, text match or time slot. Contains personal data. Read-only.

tools.name: universe_event_sales_by_day
tools.description: Return ticket sales per day for an event between two dates (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Read-only.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: universe_list_events, universe_get_event, universe_list_ticket_types, universe_list_time_slots, universe_list_orders, universe_get_order, universe_list_attendees, universe_event_sales_by_day · Public sink: universe_list_orders, universe_list_attendees.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: universe_list_events, universe_get_event, universe_list_ticket_types, universe_list_time_slots, universe_list_orders, universe_get_order, universe_list_attendees, universe_event_sales_by_day · Public sink: universe_list_orders, universe_list_attendees

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
